brief.prompt: Sales deck for Northwind Studio, a brand and web agency, pitching a rebrand to a regional bank.

outline.governing_thought: A rebrand that makes your bank look as trustworthy and modern as it truly is will win customers and strengthen loyalty, and Northwind can deliver it.
key_points: The bank's strength is not yet visible in its brand
Digital rivals are shaping customer expectations
A rebrand must change perception and behavior, not just the logo
Northwind's process ties brand, web and branch experience together
The engagement runs five months from kickoff to launch
